control._comment: Motor uses GET with signed x/y step offsets ({x}/{y} filled from `step`). IR/night uses a JSON POST to json-imp.cgi. Flip invert_x/invert_y if an arrow moves the wrong way. NOTE: add the camera-api host's IP to the camera's webui.auth_bypass_ips so control requests are allowed. The 'hls' value is a PATH; MEDIAMTX_BASE env var is prefixed to it (default http://localhost:8888).

ring.name: Ring Doorbell
ring._comment: No control block — Ring has no pan/IR HTTP API, so this renders view-only.
